name: order-desk
notice: Deterministic demonstration environment. It shows the integration working end to end; it is not evidence that learning improves an agent.

tools.name: lookup_order
tools.description: Return an order's sku, quantity and status.

tools.name: check_stock
tools.description: Return the units of a sku currently in stock.

tools.name: reserve_stock
tools.description: Reserve units of a sku for an order. Fails with error INSUFFICIENT_STOCK when quantity exceeds stock.

rules.order_of_orders: The orders a task names are the scenario's order ids, ordered by their first appearance in the task text.
rules.lookup_order: Returns {"ok": true, "order_id", "sku", "quantity", "status"}; an unknown id returns {"ok": false, "error": "UNKNOWN_ORDER"}.
rules.check_stock: Returns {"ok": true, "sku", "in_stock"}; an unknown sku returns {"ok": false, "error": "UNKNOWN_SKU"}.
rules.reserve_stock: If the order is unknown: UNKNOWN_ORDER. If sku differs from the order's sku: SKU_MISMATCH. If the order already has a reservation: ALREADY_RESERVED. If quantity <= stock: stock decreases by quantity, the order's reserved quantity becomes quantity, return {"ok": true}. Otherwise return {"ok": false, "error": "INSUFFICIENT_STOCK", "in_stock": <stock>}. Every error changes nothing.
rules.set_order_status: Sets the status and returns {"ok": true}; an unknown order returns UNKNOWN_ORDER.
rules.malformed_calls: Missing or mistyped arguments return {"ok": false, "error": "INVALID_ARGUMENTS"}; an unknown tool name returns {"ok": false, "error": "UNKNOWN_TOOL"}. Neither changes anything.
rules.verifier: Orders are handled in the order the task names them. An order passes when it ends with status 'reserved' and its full quantity reserved if the stock left after the earlier orders covered it, otherwise with status 'backordered' and nothing reserved. A task passes when every order it names passes AND each sku's final stock equals its starting stock minus the quantities reserved for it.
